response.sql: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) as type_avg_price FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) as overall_avg_price FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), above_overall AS (SELECT ta.production_type_code, ta.type_avg_price, oa.overall_avg_price FROM type_averages ta CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ta.type_avg_price > oa.overall_avg_price), mean_of_kept AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg_price) as kept_mean FROM above_overall), final_types AS (SELECT ao.production_type_code, ao.type_avg_price, ao.overall_avg_price FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN mean_of_kept mk WHERE ao.type_avg_price > mk.kept_mean) SELECT AVG(type_avg_price) as avg_type_price, AVG(type_avg_price - overall_avg_price) as avg_above_overall, AVG(type_avg_price - (SELECT kept_mean FROM mean_of_kept)) as avg_above_kept_mean FROM final_types
